summary: The label on a bag tells the return depot which household to credit.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909, outgoing CLYNK CEO Alison Vanderhoof described customers at Maine drop sites attaching a barcode linked to their own account before leaving mixed containers.
gates: A bag arrives with an account tag.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: a bag arrives with an account tag.

turns.what: The depot associates the delivery with the account.
turns.writesBack: The intake receipt carries a bag ID.

turns.what: The attendant sets the bag aside for identification.
turns.writesBack: The household's account shows no confirmed delivery yet.
